m02 3D (z = the given-ness of the world): the pole walks deeper (z +0.1 → −0.55) as 'the opening' → 'never an object' while three given marks hold nearer depths — depth is the world given through the opening, and the deepest term is never reached as an object; depth LFO = the given field breathes. m03 the cut: the walker steps cut → knowable gift → field forgotten (darkens red: the danger the record marks) while the broken token's two pieces hold apart at attract 0.5 — they signify by relation, not fusion; saw LFO on turbulence = the cut's edge.

m04 the formal limit: the system's attempt 'every condition made internal' still ends in 'a remainder' held outside by a repel force — the movement's exact claim; vortex pointer = the internal swirl that never closes on its own condition.

m05 diaphaneity as demand and method only: light → refracted → the prism visible, with two colour bands the prism makes possible. The mathematical disclosure (180°→360°) is deliberately NOT staged here — it waits for room-04 movement-25 (withholding kept).

m06 the return to zero: an open place → the bare promissory 0 → 'enfolded, before explication' — zero enters exactly as the record introduces it (promissory meta-sign; Bohm bridge); no 0/1 anywhere in this room (earned only at room-02 m18). Slowest transition 2.0 — the promise opens rather than resolves.

glyph_rationales.0: M06: zero as the promissory meta-sign for the condition a system cannot count as one more object — introduced by this movement itself (0/1 stays unearned until §1 · #5→0)
glyph_rationales.readings: M01: the panel's readings — they depend on an observer, a situation, and a horizon the panel does not display (the movement's own image)
glyph_rationales.an observer: M01: the observer the readings presuppose — the one for whom distinctions matter, whom planetary systems displace
glyph_rationales.a situation: M01: the situation of the reading — the contextual conditions (prompt, memory, permissions) that are operatively constitutive
glyph_rationales.an unshown horizon: M01: the horizon the panel does not display — the uncounted context of a formal operation; the opening refuses to begin from mechanism
glyph_rationales.#1: M02: the station chassis position — the subject as the non-objectifiable pole of a differentiating event (the raw #0…#5→0 movement addressing)
glyph_rationales.the opening: M02: the subject as the opening through which a determinate world is given
glyph_rationales.never an object: M02: treating the condition as a hidden substance inside the world would turn it into another object and repeat the error under examination
glyph_rationales.the cut: M03: determination as negational and productive — the mark exists by distinguishing it from what it is not
glyph_rationales.a knowable gift: M03: the cut's gift — a knowable object given by the distinction (the later 0/1 notation is deliberately withheld in this station)
glyph_rationales.the field forgotten: M03: the cut's danger — the achieved term forgets the field and activity from which it was cut (red = the marked danger)
glyph_rationales.an articulate system: M04: a sufficiently articulate system — Principia's attempt to make the grounds of mathematical knowledge explicit
glyph_rationales.every condition made internal: M04: the attempt to convert every condition of articulation into an ordinary internal term
glyph_rationales.a remainder: M04: what cannot be converted — the system cannot make its own conditions internal without remainder (blue = what stays outside the term)
glyph_rationales.light: M05: the appearing itself before refraction — the demand and method of diaphaneity as the record gives it here
glyph_rationales.refracted: M05: light refracted without losing the prism — the positioned seeing retained while its conditions come into view
glyph_rationales.the prism visible: M05: the prism becomes visible in the colour it makes possible — the method's demand: which sign can position the unobjectifiable?
glyph_rationales.an open place: M06: the open place in the score — the promissory meta-sign before any notation is earned
glyph_rationales.enfolded, before explication: M06: the enfolded order before local explication — the process bridge (Bohm) by which the station releases to §0
